description: This file defines types, utility functions, and logic for handling tool display configurations, including normalization, detail resolution, and formatting for a tool display system.

methods.name: asRecord
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to an ArgsRecord if it is an object, otherwise returns undefined.

methods.name: normalizeToolName
methods.description: Trims and normalizes a tool name, defaulting to 'tool' if undefined.

methods.name: defaultTitle
methods.description: Generates a default title from a name string, cleaning and capitalizing parts.

methods.name: normalizeVerb
methods.description: Trims and replaces underscores with spaces in a verb string.

methods.name: resolveActionArg
methods.description: Extracts and trims the 'action' string from an args object.

methods.name: resolveToolVerbAndDetailForArgs
methods.description: Calls resolveToolVerbAndDetail with parameters extracted from args and other inputs.

methods.name: coerceDisplayValue
methods.description: Converts a value to a string suitable for display, applying options for length, finiteness, and type.

methods.name: lookupValueByPath
methods.description: Retrieves a nested value from an object based on a dot-separated path.

methods.name: formatDetailKey
methods.description: Formats a raw detail key string into a more readable form, applying overrides if provided.

methods.name: resolvePathArg
methods.description: Extracts a path string from args, checking multiple possible fields.

methods.name: resolveReadDetail
methods.description: Generates a string describing a read operation based on args, including line ranges.

methods.name: resolveWriteDetail
methods.description: Generates a string describing a write or attach operation based on args.

methods.name: resolveWebSearchDetail
methods.description: Creates a description string for a web search based on args.

methods.name: resolveWebFetchDetail
methods.description: Creates a description string for a web fetch operation based on args.

methods.name: resolveActionSpec
methods.description: Retrieves the action specification from a ToolDisplaySpec for a given action string.

methods.name: resolveDetailFromKeys
methods.description: Resolves a detail string from args based on a list of keys, with options for mode, formatting, and max entries.

methods.name: resolveToolVerbAndDetail
methods.description: Determines the verb and detail string for a tool operation based on parameters and args.

methods.name: formatToolDetailText
methods.description: Formats a detail string, optionally prefixing with 'with' and cleaning up separators.
